titulo: Middle East crisis live: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards warns it will ‘change geography of war’ if US escalates conflict
cuerpo: The US president said in an interview ahead of the United Nations meeting that he was considering ‘wiping Iran out’ The statement comes ahead of the first debate of the annual UN General Assembly in New York, where representatives from 193 countries are gathering for an intense period of high-stakes diplomacy. The debate opens on Tuesday, runs through to Saturday, and concludes on Monday, because no sessions are held on Sunday. Continue reading...
